result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You had a breast X-ray (mammogram) on 16 September 2026. This was a check called breast screening.

You need to come back for more tests. This is called a recall.

The final result is not known yet.

Being called back does not mean that you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your appointment on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00.
2. The place is the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
3. Plan for the visit to take up to 4 hours.
4. You can bring a friend or family member with you.
5. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as you can.

At the visit, you may have more breast X-rays (mammograms). You may have an ultrasound scan. Some people may have a biopsy. This means taking a small sample of tissue. You will usually get most of your results on the same day.

## Dates and medicines

- 16 September 2026: you had your breast X-ray (mammogram).
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: your appointment at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.

The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- Why do I need more tests?
- What is an ultrasound scan?
- Which tests will I have on the day?
- When will I get all of my results?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
